description: §13.9.1 rule 4 (RULED S478): a pending tape's type carries its grants. A locked `(not to User[free, append])` cell loads its rows on mount ("ab"); the handler, with the cell discriminated, appends a row through the tape's own `append` grant ("abz") — the same edit a plain `User[free, append]` cell grants. The load's settle write needs no grant (rule 5). RUNTIME, sqlEngine "real".
rationale: §13.9.1 rule 4, RULED S478: "`let` there grants an AUTHOR write nothing beyond the tape type's own bracket grants (O3's one spelling per grant stands for author writes), and neither does the lifecycle `(not to …)`: a whole-cell author write into a pending tape, `let` or locked, needs `replace` in the tape's grants (`(not to S[replace])`) like any other tape". §66.12.3: a sequence's grants live on its type. §66.11.6 item 2: "A **pending** cell allows `T → T′` whether `let` or locked: it reloads." ruling:user-voice-scrml.md S478 "⭐ RULED — S477 owner questions 1 and 2, PA recs adopted" item 1.
